problem_description: Compute the average temperature in K, pressure in bar, and density in kg/m^3 of a cyclohexane liquid system. The system consisted of 900 cyclohexane (CHX) molecules in a cubic simulation box of dimensions 5.0 × 5.0 × 5.0 nm^3 and was modeled using the gromos43a1.ff force field. Energy minimization was performed using the steepest descent algorithm for 10000 steps with a step size of 0.002 nm. Equilibration was performed in the NPT ensemble using the md integrator with a time step of 0.002 ps for 100000 steps with neighbor list updates every 5 steps. Long-range electrostatic interactions and van der Waals interactions were treated using a cutoff scheme with a cutoff distance of 1.2 nm. All bonds were constrained using the all-bonds algorithm. Temperature coupling was applied with a coupling constant of 0.1 ps and a reference temperature of 298 K with berendsen thermostat. Pressure coupling was applied with a coupling constant of 2 ps and a reference pressure of 1.0 bar using berendsen barostate with a compressibility of 4.5e-5 bar^-1. Production runs were performed using the md integrator with a time step of 0.002 ps for 100000 steps using the same thermostat and barostat parameters.
